scope: Complete declared Linux x64 / Windows x64 runtime source collection, verified as a logical tree with exact ordered Electron patch proof. Native compilation and binary reproducibility are not claimed.
preparation_status_supersession: Embedded PART-MANIFEST.json files and original part sidecars are immutable preparation-time snapshots. Their collection-incomplete status was accurate when each part was accepted. Only this final manifest, identifying every part by exact size/SHA256 and all matching assembly/coverage evidence, supersedes that collection-level preparation status. It does not alter historical bytes, promote an individual part to a complete collection, or claim a native rebuild or reproducible binary.
